description: Rename a Replo site's dashboard display name. This does not change its SEO page title, which lives in the site's layout metadata, or its published page content. Use list_sites to find site IDs.

name.description: The new human-readable display name for the site. This is the site's name shown in the dashboard, distinct from the SEO page title in the site's layout metadata.

siteId.description: The ID of the site to rename. Use list_sites to find site IDs.

name: update_site
title: Update site
